blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines pushes forward with its medal bid at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya on Monday, September 28. Alex Eala, one of the most anticipated stars in the Games, plays her first women’s singles match, while the Alas Pilipinas women’s beach volleyball team looks to advance past the round of 16. Carlo Paalam and Nesthy Petecio also fight to advance in their respective boxing competitions on Monday.
